acceptance.given: A Replay Result is successful and its output-verification record is evaluated independently.

oracle.expected: One independent output-verification outcome is recorded for this successful Replay Result and is attributable to that result.
forbidden: Output verification inferred from another verification
oracle.observable: Replay evidence contains a distinct output-verification assertion/result keyed to the successful Replay Result.

acceptance.then: The output has been independently verified.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the replay success path with its output-verification assertion omitted or disconnected; the behavior test must observe a deterministic failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Record and enforce an independent output-verification result for every successful replay, preserving result-to-verification identity.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted schema change; retain existing replay result fields and add only independently keyed verification evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: successful replay without independent output proof -> successful replay with a distinct output-verification outcome
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The replay completes only when its own output-verification assertion passes; omission or reuse of another result's proof fails.

acceptance.given: FR-3 compilation evaluates candidate-external trust as its own verification category.

oracle.expected: A distinct candidate-external-trust verification result is present and passes independently of validator, compatibility, or support-policy results.
forbidden: Treating another verification category as candidate-external trust
oracle.observable: Compiled replay/validation evidence has a candidate-external-trust category with its own assertion and result.

acceptance.then: Candidate-external trust has been independently verified.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Compile evidence without a distinct candidate-external-trust assertion or alias it to another category; the governance contract check must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Expose candidate-external trust as an independently evaluated replay verification category with attributable evidence.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No schema migration; preserve existing replay evidence and category names while adding the required independent result.

slice_hint.state_transition: candidate-external trust required but unrepresented -> independently represented and verified
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: FR-3 compilation is accepted only when candidate-external trust has its own passing assertion and cannot be satisfied by another category.

acceptance.given: The six-case Matrix Case execution matrix is run and emits a per-case execution record.

oracle.expected: All six records identify fixture and state identities, and every identity is distinct from the corresponding identities of the other five cases.
forbidden: Cases sharing fixtures or state contrary to the distinctness requirement
oracle.observable: The six-case execution record contains six attributable fixture/state identity pairs with no duplicates.

acceptance.then: All six Matrix Cases have executed with distinct fixtures and state.
acceptance.when: When the Matrix Case execution matrix runs.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the matrix with a duplicated fixture or state identity; the structural distinctness check must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Emit and validate explicit fixture and state identities for each of six Matrix Cases, rejecting duplicates or ambiguity.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve matrix schema and existing case fields; add explicit identity validation without mutating historical records.

slice_hint.state_transition: matrix cases lack proven distinct fixture/state identities -> six attributable, pairwise-distinct identity pairs
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Matrix evaluation terminates as pass only when six records exist and fixture and state identities are pairwise distinct; otherwise fail.

acceptance.given: Frozen obligations provide independent oracles, assertions, behavior RED distinctions, and non-runtime failure-family distinctions for compilation.

oracle.expected: The compiled coverage retains every independent oracle and assertion, preserves behavior RED distinctions, and preserves each non-runtime failure family as a separate executable or structural check.
oracle.observable: Compiled obligation contracts can be enumerated one-to-one with the frozen oracle/assertion and failure-distinction records.

acceptance.when: When compiling or repairing bound obligations.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Compile coverage after removing or merging one oracle, assertion, RED distinction, or non-runtime failure family; the preservation audit must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Compile and audit independent verification contracts without merging their assertions or failure distinctions, while retaining runtime RED semantics.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing gate and replay schemas; no historical evidence rewrite and no weakening of failure-family semantics.

slice_hint.state_transition: independent verification distinctions declared but not audited -> every oracle/assertion and distinction retained and checked
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Compilation passes only when a preservation audit proves one-to-one retention of all frozen oracle, assertion, RED, and non-runtime failure distinctions.
